info.longName: First Trust S&P 500 Diversified Free Cash Flow ETF

funds_data.description: Under normal conditions, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets in the securities that comprise the index. The index measures the performance of companies within the S&P 500® Index that have the highest relative FCF Yield within each GICS® sector represented in the S&P 500® Index. It is non-diversified.
